chunks: It is God who made the cattle for you so that some you ride and some you eat.

key_terms.الْأَنْعَامَ: Livestock or cattle, specifically referring to domesticated animals like camels, cows, sheep, and goats.
key_terms.تَأْكُلُونَ: You eat, referring to the consumption of animals for food.
key_terms.تَرْكَبُوا: You ride, referring to the use of animals for transportation.

ai.seo_question: What are the primary uses of livestock mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah Ghafir, this verse underscores the divine generosity (ni'mah) by specifying the dual utility of livestock for both mobility (riding) and sustenance (eating), reflecting the Shia emphasis on recognizing God's blessings in everyday physical needs. It serves as a reminder of human stewardship over creation, linking material provision to spiritual gratitude.
